name: freegrid
description: Free, MIT-licensed, spreadsheet-like data grid for the web. Continues Handsontable 6.2.2.

scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:types && pnpm build && pnpm test:dist && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:e2e:min && pnpm test:walkontable
scripts.test:e2e: node build/build-tests.js e2e && node test/runner/run.js --suite e2e --build dev
scripts.test:e2e:min: node build/build-tests.js e2e && node test/runner/run.js --suite e2e --build min
scripts.test:walkontable: node build/build-tests.js walkontable && node test/runner/run.js --suite walkontable
